derivation: or מְחִיּיָאֵל; from H4229 (מָחָה) and H410 (אֵל); smitten of God;
def: Mechujael or Mechijael, an antediluvian patriarch

occurrences.text: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methusael: and Methusael begat Lamech.
